subject.title: fix(memory-lancedb): stop forwarding embedding dimensions upstream

question: Should memory-lancedb's direct OpenAI-compatible path own a retry-without-dimensions fallback with local truncation, or should this wait for provider-wide embedding retry policy?
rationale: The code appears correct, but fallback semantics for configured embedding dimensions are compatibility-sensitive and green tests do not decide the permanent ownership boundary.

options.title: Accept focused fallback
options.body: Land this PR after required checks because it fixes the direct memory-lancedb path without changing config, secrets, provider selection, or migrations.

options.title: Require provider-wide parity
options.body: Ask for the retry policy to move into the generic openai-compatible embedding provider before landing, accepting a broader change surface.

options.title: Pause fallback semantics
options.body: Pause or close if maintainers do not want automatic local truncation after provider field rejection.

recommendation.title: Accept focused fallback
recommendation.body: Land this PR after required checks because it fixes the direct memory-lancedb path without changing config, secrets, provider selection, or migrations.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original custom dimensions feature and most recently carried this file on main.
